sources.title: Cập nhật tên xã, phường mới của Đà Nẵng sau sáp nhập: Danh sách 94 đơn vị hành chính (reproduces Điều 1, clauses 1–92 of the resolution verbatim)
Phường Cẩm Lệ mới được sáp nhập từ các phường nào TP Đà Nẵng theo Nghị quyết 1659 (plus sibling thuviennhadat.vn pages on An Khê / Thanh Bình; corroborate clauses 1–7, 11)
Quận Liên Chiểu TP Đà Nẵng đổi thành những phường nào sau sáp nhập? (corroborates clauses 8–10)

notes: Resolution number confirmed: Nghị quyết 1659/NQ-UBTVQH15 dated 16/06/2025 (effective on signing; new commune-level governments operate from 01/07/2025), based on Đề án 403/ĐA-CP of 09/05/2025. Result: 94 commune-level units = 23 phường, 70 xã, 1 đặc khu (Hoàng Sa); 92 formed by the resolution's clauses plus 2 communes not rearranged (Tam Hải, Tân Hiệp, both ex-Quảng Nam). The official text (luatvietnam, hoatieu, thuvienphapluat, moj.gov.vn) was paywalled/403/404 to automated fetch, so the clause text was read from a verbatim reproduction (source 0) and the old-Đà Nẵng clauses were cross-checked against thuviennhadat.vn (sources 1–2); all matched. Not independently corroborated: clauses 12 (Hòa Xuân) and 24–26 (Hòa Vang, Hòa Tiến, Bà Nà). old_wards are the units as they existed on 30/06/2025, i.e. AFTER the 2023–2025 ward mergers in Hải Châu/Thanh Khê (e.g. Hải Châu I/II, Nam Dương, Bình Hiên, Hòa Thuận Đông, Tam Thuận, Tân Chính, Vĩnh Trung, Hòa Khê etc. no longer existed as separate wards and are absent here); a lookup from older addresses needs that earlier merger layer too. old_district attribution for old-Đà Nẵng units is from the pre-2025 district structure (corroborated by thuviennhadat page titles for Thanh Bình/Hải Châu, An Khê/Thạc Gián/Xuân Hà/Thanh Khê, An Hải Bắc/Sơn Trà, Mỹ An/Ngũ Hành Sơn); for ex-Quảng Nam units it is assigned from the district structure and flagged per entry. Former thị trấn (towns) are marked '(thị trấn)' in old_wards; 'Hòa Liên (một phần)' / '(phần còn lại)' mark the one split commune. No source gave coordinates; all lat/lng are null.

wards.note: An Khê ward was in Thanh Khê; Hòa An and Hòa Phát were in Cẩm Lệ. Main district chosen as the namesake ward's district.
Hòa Sơn was a commune (xã) of Hòa Vang district; the other two were wards of Liên Chiểu.

Hòa Bắc and Hòa Liên were communes of Hòa Vang; only PART of Hòa Liên went here (the rest went to phường Liên Chiểu). Hòa Bắc is large in area, so by area most of this ward is former Hòa Vang; main district chosen as Liên Chiểu because its urban wards carry the population.
Formed from Hòa Khánh Bắc ward (Liên Chiểu) plus the remainder of Hòa Liên commune (Hòa Vang) after clause 9.
Hòa Xuân was a ward of Cẩm Lệ; Hòa Châu and Hòa Phước were communes of Hòa Vang. Mapping read only from source 0 (not independently corroborated).
